title: Commercial Loan Covenant Breach Early Warning

blueprintSignals.name: Covenant headroom and slope
blueprintSignals.definition: current ratio minus threshold, plus 4-quarter linear trend

blueprintSignals.name: Revenue momentum
blueprintSignals.definition: quarter-on-quarter revenue growth from management accounts
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Management accounts arrive late and are sometimes restated

blueprintSignals.name: Liquidity cushion
blueprintSignals.definition: undrawn committed lines plus cash divided by next-12-month debt service
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Facility availability must be as at the date, not current

blueprintSignals.name: Account behaviour
blueprintSignals.definition: change in overdraft usage and payment timing on the bank's own accounts
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Only valid for borrowers whose main account is held here

label: For "Commercial Loan Covenant Breach Early Warning": Predict which corporate borrowers will breach a financial covenant in the next two quarters so relationship managers act before the breach. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Using final accounts instead of as-reported ones inflates accuracy.
